enumDescriptions: Server responses only include title, creation time and Notification ID. Note: for internal use responses also include the last update time, the latest message text and whether notification has attachments.

parent.description: Required. The parent, which owns this collection of notifications. Must be of the form "organizations/{organization}/locations/{location}" or "projects/{project}/locations/{location}".

pageSize.description: The maximum number of notifications to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified or equal to 0, at most 50 notifications will be returned. The maximum value is 50; values above 50 will be coerced to 50.
